quiet: To find the third coordinate, multiply the cosine of the latitude by the sine of the longitude.
Kinetic energy is one half of the mass times the square of the velocity.
The distance is the square root of the sum of the squared differences.
Density is simply the mass divided by the volume of the sample.
The angle comes from the arctangent of the rise over the run.
The area of a circle is pi times the radius squared.
The height of the wave follows a sine curve over time.
The shear modulus depends on Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio.
